name: @repo/domain
description: Pure, isomorphic thread domain vendored from bb: the thread lifecycle as data ((status, event) → status table plus supersession predicates), the ThreadEvent zod grammar trimmed to the item kinds v1 emits, the per-event-type scope policy table, the provider-neutral approval grammar, and the invalidation vocabulary with the DbNotifier seam the write layer announces through. No node, no db, no transport — every consumer parses at its own boundary with these schemas.
